description: This file defines geometric shape types and functions for creating, transforming, and analyzing shapes such as polygons, ellipses, curves, and lines, primarily for collision detection and geometric computations in Excalidraw.

methods.name: getPolygonShape
methods.description: Generates a polygon geometric shape from a rectangular element, considering rotation and type (diamond or rectangle).

methods.name: getSelectionBoxShape
methods.description: Calculates the selection box shape for an element, with optional padding and rotation.

methods.name: getEllipseShape
methods.description: Creates an ellipse shape based on element dimensions and rotation.

methods.name: getCurvePathOps
methods.description: Extracts path operations from a drawable shape, used for curve reconstruction.

methods.name: getCurveShape
methods.description: Constructs a curve shape from roughjs drawable, applying rotation and positioning.

methods.name: polylineFromPoints
methods.description: Creates a polyline (array of line segments) from a list of points.

methods.name: getFreedrawShape
methods.description: Generates a shape (polygon or polyline) from free-draw points, with optional closure.

methods.name: getClosedCurveShape
methods.description: Creates a polygon shape from a linear element, or from bezier curves if rounded.

methods.name: segmentIntersectRectangleElement
methods.description: Finds intersections between a line segment and a rectangular element's bounds.

methods.name: distanceToEllipse
methods.description: Calculates the distance from a point to an ellipse.

methods.name: pointOnEllipse
methods.description: Checks if a point lies on an ellipse within a threshold.

methods.name: pointInEllipse
methods.description: Checks if a point is inside an ellipse.

methods.name: ellipseAxes
methods.description: Returns the major and minor axes lengths of an ellipse.

methods.name: ellipseFocusToCenter
methods.description: Calculates the distance from the focus to the center of an ellipse.

methods.name: ellipseExtremes
methods.description: Returns the extreme points of an ellipse along its axes.
